name: Trampling Charge
description: If the monstrosity moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the monstrosity can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.
